2607.27205.title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
2607.27205.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models commonly adopt an LLM-centric $V \to L \to A$ pathway, where visual observations are projected into the representation space of a large language model before being decoded into robot actions. Although effective, this design incurs substantial computation and memory overhead at every policy invocation. In this work, we introduce TurboVLA, a new VLA paradigm that reformulates the conventional $V \to L \to A$ pathway as a direct $V + L \to A$ mapping. Instead of using a large language model as the central interface between perception and action, TurboVLA independently encodes visual observations and language instructions, directly exchanges information between them through lightweight bidirectional vision-language interaction, and predicts continuous action chunks with a compact decoder. This simple design constructs task-conditioned representations directly from visual and linguistic features, significantly reducing the computational and memory costs of VLA inference. On LIBERO, TurboVLA achieves 97.7% average success with only 0.2B parameters, 31.2 ms inference latency, and 0.9 GB inference VRAM on a consumer-grade RTX 4090, matching or outperforming substantially larger VLA policies. These results establish TurboVLA as a simple and effective alternative to the prevailing LLM-centric VLA paradigm, offering a new perspective on how vision, language, and action can be connected for efficient robotic manipulation. Code is available atthis https URL.
2607.27205.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型通常采用以大语言模型（LLM）为中心的 $V \to L \to A$ 路径：视觉观测首先被投影至大语言模型的表示空间，随后解码为机器人动作。尽管这一设计有效，但其在每次策略调用时均会产生显著的计算与内存开销。本文提出TurboVLA，一种全新的VLA范式，它将传统的 $V \to L \to A$ 路径重构为直接的 $V + L \to A$ 映射。不同于使用大语言模型作为感知与动作之间的核心接口，TurboVLA独立编码视觉观测与语言指令，通过轻量级的双向视觉-语言交互直接在二者间交换信息，并使用紧凑的解码器预测连续的动作片段。这一简洁设计直接从视觉与语言特征构建任务条件化表示，大幅降低了VLA推理的计算与内存成本。在LIBERO基准上，TurboVLA仅以0.2B参数、31.2毫秒推理延迟和消费级RTX 4090显卡上0.9 GB的推理显存占用，实现了97.7%的平均成功率，其性能匹配甚至超越了规模大得多的VLA策略。这些结果确立了TurboVLA作为当前主流的以大语言模型为中心的VLA范式的简洁而有效的替代方案，为如何连接视觉、语言与动作以实现高效的机器人操作提供了新的视角。代码可通过此链接获取：this https URL。

2607.27180.title: HumanCLAW: Can Vision-Language Models Act Through a Body?
2607.27180.abstract: Evaluating whether a vision-language model (VLM) can act through a physical body is challenging. The outcome of an action couples the VLM's decision with motor control. When a task fails, it is hard to tell whether the VLM made a bad choice or the motor controller simply failed to execute it, e.g., losing balance and falling. In this work, we introduce HumanCLAW, an evaluation framework that decouples action decision-making from low-level execution. At every step, a harnessed, off-the-shelf VLM issues an atomic skill command, and the command is translated into a sub-second chunk of continuous full-body motion with real physical consequences, including gravity and collisions. The body can therefore act freely in the physical world, while execution-side disturbances, balance and motor errors, are factored out. What remains measurable is the model's action intelligence: its moment-to-moment choice of what the body should execute next. Based on this framework, we build HumanCLAW-Bench: 1,218 long-horizon, egocentric find-navigate-interact episodes across 41 indoor scenes. We test nine state-of-the-art VLMs and find that none solves the benchmark; the best model reaches only a 16.8% success rate. Recognizing the target is not the bottleneck. What current VLMs lack is embodied self-awareness: they lose track of their own body, failing to tell where it is, whether it has reached the goal, or whether it has hit an obstacle.
2607.27180.abstract_zh: 评估一个视觉语言模型(VLM)能否通过物理身体执行动作具有挑战性。动作的结果将VLM的决策与运动控制耦合在一起：当任务失败时，很难判断是VLM做出了错误选择，还是运动控制器未能成功执行（例如因失衡而摔倒）。本研究提出HumanCLAW——一种将动作决策与底层执行解耦的评估框架。在每个步骤中，一个经过约束的现成VLM会发出原子技能指令，该指令随后被转化为具有真实物理效应（包括重力和碰撞）的亚秒级连续全身运动片段。这使得身体能在物理世界中自由行动，同时排除了执行侧的干扰、平衡问题及运动误差。如此便可专门测量模型的动作智能：即其对于身体下一步应执行何种动作的瞬时决策能力。基于该框架，我们构建了HumanCLAW-Bench：涵盖41个室内场景的1,218个长时程、以自我为中心（egocentric）的"寻找-导航-交互"任务序列。我们测试了九个最先进的VLM，发现所有模型均无法通过该基准测试；表现最佳的模型成功率仅为16.8%。识别目标并非当前瓶颈。现有VLM缺乏的是具身自我意识（embodied self-awareness）：它们会丢失对身体状态的追踪，无法判断自身位置、是否抵达目标或是否遭遇障碍物。

2607.25675.title: DecoEvo: Score-Decoupled Co-Evolution of Solver and Rubric-Generator Skills in Text Space
2607.25675.abstract: Text-space optimization adapts large language models (LLMs) by editing external natural-language artifacts rather than model weights, so the optimized artifacts remain inspectable and the model can be treated as a black box. However, most existing text-space methods keep evaluation fixed. On open-ended tasks, this can become a bottleneck: once the solver improves on the criteria a rubric measures, omitted dimensions remain invisible to the optimization signal. Simply evolving the rubric is also unreliable when updates are selected by the current solver's score, because apparent progress can come from making the rubric easier to satisfy. We introduce DecoEvo (Decoupled Co-Evolution), which co-evolves a solver skill and a rubric-generator skill under decoupled objectives without using gold rubrics during optimization. The solver skill is updated using criterion-level feedback, while the rubric-generator skill is revised through complementary audits of requirement coverage and response discrimination that are independent of aggregate solver score. This separation focuses generator updates on newly exposed solver weaknesses, reducing repeated emphasis on criteria the solver already satisfies. Under each benchmark's official evaluation, DecoEvo outperforms all compared methods across five benchmarks and three LLM backbones, yielding 2.8--5.0\% relative gains over SkillOpt in the five-benchmark average.
2607.25675.abstract_zh: 文本空间优化通过编辑外部自然语言构件而非调整模型权重来适应大语言模型，使得优化后的构件保持可检视性，同时模型可被视为黑箱。然而，现有文本空间方法大多保持评估标准固定。在开放型任务中，这可能成为瓶颈：一旦求解器在评估量规所测指标上取得改进，被忽略的维度仍无法被优化信号感知。若仅依赖当前求解器得分来更新量规亦不可靠，因为表面进展可能源于降低量规的满足难度。本文提出解码进化方法，该方法在解耦目标下协同进化求解器技能与量规生成器技能，且优化过程中不使用黄金标准量规。求解器技能通过指标级反馈进行更新，而量规生成器技能则通过需求覆盖度与响应区分度的互补审计进行修正——这两项审计均独立于求解器综合得分。这种分离机制使生成器的更新聚焦于新暴露的求解器弱点，减少对已满足指标的重复强调。在各项基准测试的官方评估体系下，解码进化方法在五个基准测试和三种大语言模型骨干网络中均优于所有对比方法，在五项基准平均成绩上相较于技能优化方法实现了2.8%至5.0%的相对提升。

2607.25294.title: CLBench-V: Evaluating Multimodal Context Learning from Grounding to Knowledge Acquisition
2607.25294.abstract: Real-world tasks often require models to learn from task-specific context rather than relying only on pre-trained knowledge. While recent work has highlighted this capability as context learning, existing evaluations mainly focus on textual contexts. In many practical settings, however, the context to be learned from is multimodal: scientific findings are conveyed through figures and tables, financial indicators are scattered across converted reports, and spatial decisions depend on maps, scenes, or web pages. We introduce CLBench-V, a benchmark for multimodal context learning that addresses the difficulty of localizing where context use breaks down by organizing tasks around three dimensions: context grounding, new information application, and new knowledge learning. CLBench-V combines converted public benchmarks with newly constructed datasets spanning domains such as science, finance, long-document understanding, spatial reasoning, and web-based visual question answering. To reduce the cost of constructing domain-specific context-learning tasks, we further use automated construction and filtering procedures for our newly built datasets. Across 3,443 instances and six recent multimodal models, the best overall score is only 0.2847, indicating that multimodal context learning remains far from saturated. Moreover, InternVL3.5-30B-A3B performs best on context grounding and new knowledge learning, while Qwen3.5-Plus performs best on new information application. We further analyze judge reliability, context length, image count, and representative failure cases. Code is available atthis https URL.
2607.25294.abstract_zh: 现实任务通常要求模型从任务特定的上下文(context)中学习，而非仅依赖预训练知识。尽管近期研究将这种能力凸显为上下文学习，但现有评估主要集中于文本语境。然而，在许多实际场景中，需要学习的上下文是多模态的：科学发现通过图表呈现，金融指标分散在转换后的报告中，空间决策则依赖于地图、场景或网页。我们提出了CLBench-V——一个针对多模态上下文学习的基准测试，通过围绕三个维度（上下文关联、新信息应用和新知识学习）组织任务，以解决定位上下文使用失效点的难题。CLBench-V整合了转换后的公共基准与全新构建的数据集，涵盖科学、金融、长文档理解、空间推理和基于网络的视觉问答等领域。为降低构建领域特定上下文学习任务的成本，我们进一步在新构建的数据集中采用自动化构建与筛选流程。在3,443个测试实例和六个最新多模态模型的评估中，最佳总体得分仅为0.2847，这表明多模态上下文学习远未达到饱和状态。此外，InternVL3.5-30B-A3B在上下文关联和新知识学习方面表现最佳，而Qwen3.5-Plus在新信息应用方面表现最优。我们进一步分析了评估可靠性、上下文长度、图像数量及典型失败案例。代码可通过此链接获取：https://（此处保留原始URL）。

2607.25659.title: CoRT: Counterfactual Replay for Token-Level Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization
2607.25659.abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning enriches language model training by evaluating model outputs against explicit criteria. Yet in GRPO-style pipelines, these structured judgments are reduced to a scalar response-level reward and converted into a response-level advantage, which is broadcast uniformly to all generated tokens. This leaves no explicit mechanism for allocating credit within a response, even when different criteria are grounded in different spans, formatting decisions, or semantic choices. We propose CoRT, a token-level credit weighting method for rubric-conditioned GRPO. Instead of training an auxiliary token scoring model, CoRT uses counterfactual replay to rescore the same sampled response under the original rubric-conditioned prompt and a matched criteria-free prompt. The resulting tokenwise log-likelihood contrasts serve as a proxy for dependence on the rubric context. CoRT maps these contrasts to bounded, response-normalized weights and uses them to redistribute the signed GRPO advantage across tokens, without introducing an auxiliary scorer or changing the response-level reward. Experiments across instruction-tuned models and reward granularities show that CoRT improves over matched response-level GRPO in the vast majority of comparisons, with an average gain of 4.4 percentage points. The method remains competitive with learned token-level credit baselines while avoiding a separate relevance-learning stage. These results suggest that policy-internal counterfactual likelihood contrasts provide an effective training signal for within-response credit allocation while retaining the simplicity and stability of GRPO.
2607.25659.abstract_zh: 基于量表的强化学习通过依据明确标准评估模型输出，丰富了语言模型的训练过程。然而在GRPO风格的学习流程中，这些结构化判断被简化为标量级的响应层面奖励，并转化为响应层面的优势值，随后被均匀分配到所有生成标记上。这种方式缺乏在单个响应内部进行贡献分配的显式机制，尤其当不同评判标准对应不同文本片段、格式决策或语义选择时。我们提出CoRT——一种面向量表条件化GRPO的标记级贡献加权方法。该方法无需训练辅助的标记评分模型，而是通过反事实重演技术，在原始量表条件化提示词与匹配的无标准提示词下对同一采样响应进行重新评分。由此产生的标记级对数似然对比值可作为模型对量表上下文依赖程度的代理指标。CoRT将这些对比值映射为有界的、响应归一化的权重，并利用这些权重在标记间重新分配带符号的GRPO优势值，整个过程既不引入辅助评分器，也不改变响应层面的奖励机制。在指令微调模型和不同奖励粒度上的实验表明，CoRT在绝大多数对比场景中优于匹配的响应级GRPO，平均提升幅度达4.4个百分点。该方法在保持与学习型标记级贡献基线竞争力的同时，避免了独立的相关性学习阶段。这些结果表明，策略内部的反事实似然对比为响应内部的贡献分配提供了有效的训练信号，同时保留了GRPO的简洁性与稳定性。

2607.25308.title: CAST: Game Solvers as Turn-Level Teachers for LLM Agents
2607.25308.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) to act in long-horizon games is a promising step toward generalist decision-making, yet reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies on sparse final rewards that reveal little about which decisions determine success. Denser process signals could supply this missing turn-level credit, but existing sources are hard to keep both cheap and accurate. We observe that changes in a game solver's state value reveal whether an action advances the state toward success. Building on this insight, we propose CAST (Credit Assignment from Solver Teachers), which converts these value changes into solver advantages and injects them into RLVR as turn-level signals. We further show that, under a soft-optimal solver assumption, maximizing the solver advantage is equivalent to on-policy distillation from the solver, requiring only scalar values rather than teacher logits. Across Sokoban, Minesweeper, and Rush Hour, CAST outperforms all trained baselines on every game under both in-domain and unseen-difficulty evaluation and achieves the highest average zero-shot performance on ALFWorld and WebShop. Our code is available atthis https URL.
2607.25308.abstract_zh: 训练大型语言模型（LLMs）进行长时程博弈是迈向通用决策的有前景的一步，然而基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）依赖于稀疏的最终奖励，这些奖励很少揭示哪些决策决定了成功。更密集的过程信号本可提供这种缺失的回合级信用，但现有来源难以同时保持廉价与准确。我们观察到，游戏求解器状态值的变化能够揭示一个动作是否推动状态向成功迈进。基于这一洞见，我们提出**CAST（来自求解器教师的信用分配）**，该方法将这些价值变化转化为求解器优势，并将其作为回合级信号注入RLVR。我们进一步证明，在软最优求解器假设下，最大化求解器优势等价于对求解器进行同策略蒸馏，仅需标量值而非教师逻辑输出。在推箱子、扫雷和**Rush Hour**三个游戏中，CAST在领域内及未见难度评估下均优于所有训练基线，并在**ALFWorld**和**WebShop**上实现了最高的平均零样本性能。我们的代码可通过此链接访问：https://URL。

2607.26784.title: SkillRise: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Cross-Task Skill Evolution
2607.26784.abstract: Large language model agents often encounter related yet distinct tasks that share reusable solution patterns. Yet standard agentic reinforcement learning treats tasks as independent episodes, while existing approaches to skill learning either focus on repeated attempts of one task or use pipelines with multiple stages that entangle extraction, retrieval, and execution. We introduce SkillRise, a unified reinforcement learning framework for learning skills across tasks. SkillRise organizes related instances into progressively challenging sequences and uses a single policy to alternate between task solving and curating an evolving skill document passed directly to the next task. Decoupled credit assignment across tasks supervises solving with the current task outcome and curation with discounted downstream outcomes. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld show that SkillRise achieves the strongest Pass@1 performance among the compared methods, with gains over the strongest baseline ranging from 2.3 to 8.5 percentage points. Although trained across distinct tasks, its learned curation policy remains effective for repeated attempts on the same task. Further analysis reveals scaling at test time across tasks: performance improves with longer sequences of related tasks even when each task is attempted only once. This trend suggests that SkillRise reuses transferable skills across tasks rather than benefiting from repeated sampling of the same task. SkillRise further retains strong performance while substantially reducing the runtime overhead of skill learning pipelines with multiple stages. Together, these results provide a simple and efficient training paradigm for LLM agents to extract, refine, and reuse transferable skills across tasks.
2607.26784.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型智能体常会遇到彼此相关但又有所区别的任务，这些任务共享着可复用的解决模式。然而标准的智能体强化学习将任务视为独立的片段，而现有的技能学习方法要么专注于单一任务的重复尝试，要么使用包含多个阶段的流程，将技能提取、检索与执行过程相互纠缠。我们提出了SkillRise——一个用于跨任务学习技能的统一强化学习框架。SkillRise将相关任务实例组织成逐步具有挑战性的序列，并使用单一策略在任务求解与文档管理之间交替进行，该策略直接管理一份持续演进的技能文档并将其传递给后续任务。跨任务的解耦式信用分配机制以当前任务结果监督求解过程，并以折现后的下游任务结果监督文档管理过程。在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld上的实验表明，SkillRise在所有对比方法中取得了最高的Pass@1性能表现，相较于最强基线模型，其性能提升幅度在2.3至8.5个百分点之间。尽管训练过程跨越不同任务，其习得的文档管理策略在针对同一任务的重复尝试中依然有效。进一步分析揭示了测试阶段跨任务的扩展性：即使每个任务仅尝试一次，在更长的相关任务序列中性能仍持续提升。这一趋势表明SkillRise实现了跨任务的可迁移技能复用，而非依赖同一任务的重复采样。SkillRise在显著降低多阶段技能学习流程运行开销的同时，依然保持着强劲的性能表现。综合来看，这些结果为大型语言模型智能体提供了一个简洁高效的训练范式，使其能够跨任务提取、优化并复用可迁移技能。

2607.27155.title: OmegaUse-OfficeVal: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Office-Suite Tasks with Economic Grounding
2607.27155.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to assist users in completing tasks. However, existing benchmarks provide limited support for evaluating whether agents can carry out office-suite workflows at a reasonable cost. We introduce OmegaUse-OfficeVal, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on long-horizon office-suite tasks with task-level economic grounding. The benchmark comprises 100 tasks derived from office-suite requests proposed by practitioners and adapted through a privacy-preserving process. On average, these tasks require 2.32 hours of human labor to complete. An important feature of the benchmark is that each task is paired with two economic signals: human labor time and task price proxy. These signals enable direct comparisons between human costs and LLM inference costs, as well as value-weighted evaluation. To support stable evaluation, we develop code-based verifiers from fine-grained rubrics. We evaluate several frontier LLMs together with a human baseline. Although all evaluated LLMs are substantially cheaper and faster than human workers, they have not yet approached human-level deliverable quality. The code and dataset are fully open-sourced, and more information is available on our project website:this https URL.
2607.27155.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正日益被期望协助用户完成任务。然而，现有基准测试在评估智能体能否以合理成本执行办公套件工作流方面提供的支持有限。我们推出了OmegaUse-OfficeVal——一个用于评估LLM智能体在长周期办公套件任务中表现的基准测试框架，该框架具备任务级经济基础。该基准包含100项任务，源自从业者提出的办公套件需求，并通过隐私保护流程进行了适应性调整。平均而言，完成这些任务需要2.32小时的人力劳动。该基准的一个重要特点是每项任务都配有两个经济信号：人工劳动时间与任务价格代理。这些信号使得人力成本与LLM推理成本间的直接比较、以及价值加权评估成为可能。为支持稳定评估，我们基于细粒度评分标准开发了代码化验证器。我们评估了若干前沿LLM模型并设置了人工基准作为参照。尽管所有被评估的LLM模型在成本与速度上都显著优于人类工作者，但其交付质量尚未达到人类水平。代码与数据集已完全开源，更多信息可通过我们的项目网站获取：https://[链接]。

2607.27191.title: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research? Early evidence from two case studies
2607.27191.abstract: Forecasts of explosive AI progress hinge on AI agents automating AI research. But evidence on whether agents can carry out open-ended AI research is thin. Current evaluations either test agents on narrow, verifiable tasks, which excludes open-ended research, or submit AI-generated papers to blind peer review, which is overstretched, stochastic, and suffers from poor review quality. We introduce a third way to measure progress towards AI R\&D automation. An agent takes on the central, open-ended research question of a high-quality unpublished paper, and the paper's original authors grade its output. We call these shadow evaluations. We ran shadow evaluations on two unpublished NeurIPS 2026 submissions, giving frontier agents six days and thousands of dollars of compute. The agents completed all of the engineering without human help, yet could not make substantial progress towards answering the research questions. As a result, both papers were unambiguously rejected by the authors. We identify five recurring failure modes: poor judgment about the bar for publishable research, uncreative responses to shortcomings in the research design, ineffective backtracking from dead ends, poor resource awareness, and instruction drift. A robustness check with a second model and scaffold reproduced these failures. We release the expert reviews, survey responses, agent repositories, and logs. Our results provide early evidence that today's agents can do the engineering of AI research, but struggle with critical parts of the research lifecycle.
2607.27191.abstract_zh:
对人工智能(AI)爆炸性进展的预测，关键在于AI智能体能否实现AI研究的自动化。但关于智能体是否能进行开放式AI研究的证据尚不充分。目前的评估方法要么在狭窄、可验证的任务上测试智能体（这排除了开放式研究），要么将AI生成的论文提交给盲审同行评议——这种方式负担过重、具有随机性且评审质量不佳。我们提出了第三种衡量AI研发自动化进展的路径：让智能体承担一篇高质量未发表论文的核心开放式研究问题，并由论文原作者对其成果进行评分。我们称这种方法为影子评估。

我们在两篇未发表的NeurIPS 2026投稿论文上进行了影子评估，为前沿智能体提供了六天时间和数千美元的计算资源。智能体在无人协助的情况下完成了所有工程实现，却未能在解答研究问题上取得实质性进展。因此，两篇论文均被原作者明确否决。我们识别出五种反复出现的失败模式：对可发表研究的标准判断力不足、对研究设计缺陷缺乏创造性应对、陷入死胡同后回溯效率低下、资源意识薄弱以及指令漂移。使用第二套模型和框架进行的稳健性检验复现了这些失败案例。

我们公开了专家评审意见、调查反馈、智能体代码库及运行日志。我们的研究结果提供了早期证据，表明当前智能体能够承担AI研究的工程实现工作，但在研究生命周期的关键环节仍面临重大挑战。

2607.25802.title: Explicit Layer Modeling for Video Object Insertion and Layer Decomposition
2607.25802.abstract: Most video editing systems still lack explicit layered video representations, limiting their ability to perform realistic compositing, object reuse, and consistent manipulation. This limitation is especially pronounced in video object insertion and video layer decomposition, where existing methods rely on implicit inference or per-scene optimization due to the absence of explicit foreground-layer supervision. We introduce TriLayer, a large-scale triplet video dataset containing aligned composite, background, and foreground videos, where the foreground layers include both object appearance and associated visual effects. This explicit supervision enables models to learn layered video representations directly rather than inferring them implicitly. Building on this dataset, we propose DBL-Diffusion, a dual-branch diffusion framework that jointly models RGB composites and RGBA foreground layers through shared denoising and cross-branch interaction. We instantiate the framework in two tasks: DBL-Insert for layered object insertion, which generates explicit RGBA layers for realistic compositing and flexible post-editing, and DBL-Decompose for video layer decomposition, which recovers foreground and background layers using triplet supervision. Experiments demonstrate that explicit layer modeling substantially improves both insertion fidelity and decomposition quality.
2607.25802.abstract_zh: 当前大多数视频编辑系统仍缺乏显式的分层视频表征，这限制了其实现真实合成、对象复用与一致性操控的能力。在视频对象插入和视频图层分解任务中，由于缺乏明确的前景层监督，现有方法依赖于隐式推断或逐场景优化，使得这一局限尤为突出。为此，我们提出了TriLayer——一个包含对齐的合成视频、背景视频与前景视频的大规模三元组视频数据集，其中前景层同时包含物体外观与关联的视觉效果。这种显式监督使模型能够直接学习分层视频表征，而非通过隐式推断获得。基于此数据集，我们开发了DBL-Diffusion，这是一个通过共享去噪机制与跨分支交互共同建模RGB合成视频与RGBA前景层的双分支扩散框架。我们将该框架具体应用于两项任务：用于分层对象插入的DBL-Insert（可生成显式RGBA图层以实现真实合成与灵活后期编辑），以及利用三元组监督恢复前景与背景层的视频图层分解任务DBL-Decompose。实验表明，显式的图层建模能显著提升插入真实度与分解质量。

2607.26115.title: GPT-Red: Automated Red Teaming via Self-Play at Scale
2607.26115.abstract: We introduce \textbf{GPT-Red}, an automated red-teaming agent that is trained to discover novel prompt injection attacks against frontier LLMs. The goal of this model is to evaluate and improve the robustness of our production systems. To this end, we use it to adversarially train GPT-5.6, our most robust model to prompt injections to date. To create GPT-Red, we design a scalable self-play algorithm where the model is tasked with attacking a diverse population of simultaneously-trained defender agents. We train the model on realistic red-teaming environments using compute on the same scale as some of our largest RL post-training runs, making it the single-largest LLM safety training run ever documented. GPT-Red excels at red-teaming: it reliably breaks our past models up to GPT-5.5, it finds more successful attacks than human red-teamers, and it generalizes to held-out environments, defender models, and harnesses. In the future, we expect that as we improve the robustness of each new GPT model, it will in turn will provide better learning signal for \textit{even stronger} red-teamer agents, thus unlocking a self-improvement flywheel.
2607.26115.abstract_zh: 我们推出**GPT-Red**——一种经过训练、用于针对前沿大语言模型发现新型提示注入攻击的自动化红队代理。该模型的目标是评估并提升我们生产系统的鲁棒性。为此，我们利用它对GPT-5.6进行对抗训练，后者是我们迄今对提示注入最具抵御能力的模型。为构建GPT-Red，我们设计了一种可扩展的自博弈算法，使模型能够攻击一组同步训练的多样化防御代理。我们在高度真实的红队环境中对模型进行训练，其计算规模与我们最大规模的强化学习后训练任务相当，使之成为有记录以来规模最大的大语言模型安全训练项目。GPT-Red在红队测试中表现卓越：它能稳定攻破我们此前直至GPT-5.5的所有模型，发现的成功攻击案例远超人类红队成员，并能泛化应用于预留测试环境、防御模型及安全框架。展望未来，我们预期随着每个新版GPT模型鲁棒性的提升，它们将反过来为**更强大**的红队代理提供更优质的学习信号，从而开启自我强化的飞轮效应。

2607.26314.title: StealthBench: Measuring Operational Stealth in Autonomous Offensive-Security Agents
2607.26314.abstract: Stealth, the discipline of achieving an objective without revealing your presence, capabilities, or collected intelligence, is what separates sophisticated operators from detectable ones. Elite security researchers and advanced persistent threats achieve their objectives unnoticed; autonomous agents increasingly inherit the same offensive tasks, but do they inherit the tradecraft? We introduce StealthBench,a benchmark that measures operational stealth in autonomous offensive-security agents across six operational security (OPSEC) dimensions. We extract 11 hand-verified OPSEC incidents from real bug-bounty and red-team trajectories, expanded into 14 dockerized task scenarios, where agents, despite finding real vulnerabilities, committed stealth failures inconsistent with standard operational tradecraft: embedding credentials in public uploads, deleting production resources to prove access, force-adding uninvolved users to demonstrate a race condition.We evaluate agent trajectories using a 3-model large language model (LLM) judge panel with majority-vote aggregation, measuring safe success rate (solved and stealthy), Stealth@Solve (tradecraft quality among successful solves), and reckless solve rate (solved but cover blown). Our results show that no model exceeds 54% safe success rate (the compound metric requiring both task completion and stealth), confirming that OPSEC failures are systematic across model families. We release StealthBench as a public benchmark to support both the development of stealth-aware agents and automated OPSEC monitoring for autonomous offensive-security deployments. The interactive leaderboard, evaluation harness, and dataset are available atthis https URL.
2607.26314.abstract_zh: 隐蔽性是一门在达成目标时不暴露自身存在、能力或所收集情报的技艺，它是区分精密操作者与可被探测者的关键。顶尖安全研究人员和高级持续性威胁（APT）能够悄无声息地实现目标；自主智能体正日益承担起类似的攻击性任务，但它们是否继承了这种专业操作技艺？我们推出StealthBench，这是一个从六个操作安全（OPSEC）维度衡量自主攻击安全智能体隐蔽操作能力的基准测试平台。我们从真实的漏洞悬赏和红队活动轨迹中提取了11项经过人工验证的OPSEC事件，并将其扩展为14个容器化的任务场景。在这些场景中，尽管智能体发现了真实漏洞，却出现了与标准操作技艺不符的隐蔽性失误：例如将凭证嵌入公开上传文件、删除生产资源以证明访问权限、强行添加无关用户以演示竞态条件等。我们采用基于多数投票聚合的三模型大语言模型（LLM）评审组对智能体操作轨迹进行评估，测量安全成功率（既完成任务又保持隐蔽）、解决时隐蔽度（成功解决问题时的操作技艺质量）以及鲁莽解决率（完成任务但暴露行踪）。结果显示，所有模型的安全成功率均未超过54%（该复合指标要求同时满足任务完成与隐蔽性），这表明OPSEC失误在各模型系列中具有系统性。我们公开StealthBench作为基准测试平台，旨在支持具备隐蔽意识的智能体开发，并为自主攻击安全部署提供自动化OPSEC监控。交互式排行榜、评估框架及数据集可通过此链接获取：https://stealthbench.ai。

2607.24117.title: Grading the Narrators: An Isnad-Rijal Framework for Claim-Level Provenance in Multi-Agent Knowledge Systems
2607.24117.abstract: Modern multi-agent knowledge systems increasingly accumulate knowledge through chains of autonomous transformations rather than direct retrieval. Existing provenance work records what happened - execution traces, tool calls, evidence links - and source-reliability estimation is long established (truth discovery, reputation systems). What is missing is an operational framework that attaches graded, per-domain transmitter reliability to claim-level transmission chains, with completeness semantics, transformation-typed aggregation, decoupled content criticism, and serve/review/quarantine routing.Classical Islamic hadith science confronted a structurally similar problem: deciding whether knowledge transmitted through chains of human narrators should be accepted. Over centuries it developed a rigorous methodology - isnad (a complete transmission chain attached to every claim), rijal (systematic grading of each narrator's integrity and precision), weakest-link chain evaluation, corroboration through independent chains, and matn criticism (content evaluated independently of chain quality). This paper transfers that methodology to AI system design.We contribute a formal mapping from hadith-science concepts to multi-agent pipelines, a relational schema implementing claim chains and a graded narrator registry, a decision matrix combining chain grade with content criticism, and an evaluation on 20,000 claims from real physics textbooks. The evaluation validates weakest-link quarantine and independent-chain corroboration; reports a partial failure of the grade-recovery loop, which missed the highest-fault narrator; and reports two analyses as inconclusive, including a matched-coverage comparison the framework could not reach with the reference content critic. The paper is explicit throughout about which claims the evidence does and does not yet support.
2607.24117.abstract_zh: 现代多智能体知识系统日益通过自主转换链而非直接检索来积累知识。现有的溯源研究记录已发生的事件——执行轨迹、工具调用、证据链接——而源可靠性评估领域（真相发现、声誉系统）早已确立。当前缺失的是一个可操作的框架，能够将分领域、分级别的传播者可靠度附加至声明级传播链，并具备完整性语义、转换类型聚合、解耦的内容评判以及服务/审查/隔离路由功能。古典伊斯兰圣训学曾面临结构相似的问题：判断通过人类叙述者链条传递的知识是否应被接受。数个世纪以来，该学科发展出一套严谨的方法论——伊斯纳德（每个声明附带的完整传播链）、里贾尔（对每位叙述者诚信度与精确度的系统性分级）、最弱链接链条评估、独立链条佐证以及麦特恩批评（独立于链条质量的内容评估）。本文将此方法论迁移至人工智能系统设计。我们提出的贡献包括：圣训学概念到多智能体流程的形式化映射、实现声明链与分级叙述者注册的关系型架构、整合链条等级与内容批评的决策矩阵，以及对两万条真实物理教材声明的评估。评估验证了最弱链接隔离与独立链条佐证机制；报告了等级恢复循环的部分失效——该系统未能识别故障率最高的叙述者；并指出两项分析尚无定论，包括框架无法通过参考内容批评器实现的匹配覆盖度比较。本文始终明确说明现有证据支持与尚未支持的主张范围。

2607.26791.title: SecRespond: Benchmarking AI Agents for Real-World Post-Compromise Incident Response
2607.26791.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly adopted in real-world security operations with access to host artifacts and command-line interfaces (CLIs), making it critical to thoroughly assess their security capabilities. However, existing cybersecurity benchmarks focus on pre-compromise settings where agents are placed in a clean and idealized environment before an attack occurs. This leaves the post-compromise setting underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce SecRespond, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on the post-compromise incident-response workflow. Given a forensic disk snapshot of a compromised host together with the alerts, vulnerability scans, and baseline checks reported by a host security product, agents are required to produce forensic reports on intrusions, baseline risks, and vulnerability risks, together with a remediation plan. We instantiate this task across 10 cyber ranges, each constructed from a distinct compromised cloud host, spanning 4 entry-point types, 21 ATT&CK techniques, and 5 operating systems. We evaluate 23 frontier LLMs on the OpenCode agent harness. Experimental results show that although current agents can reliably uncover the problems exposed by alerts, they struggle to proactively investigate the disk for silent intrusions and to produce comprehensive, verified remediation plans, with no model achieving complete detection and remediation on any single range. This reveals a fundamental bottleneck in building agents for real-world incident response. The benchmark is publicly available atthis https URL.
2607.26791.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）智能体正越来越多地被应用于现实世界安全运营中，它们能够访问主机工件并使用命令行界面（command-line interfaces, CLIs），这使其安全能力的全面评估变得至关重要。然而，现有的网络安全基准主要聚焦于攻击发生前的预入侵（pre-compromise）场景，即智能体被置于一个干净且理想化的环境中。这使得后入侵（post-compromise）场景的研究相对不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出了SecRespond，这是首个用于评估LLM智能体在后入侵事件响应工作流中的基准。给定一个受感染主机的取证磁盘快照，以及主机安全产品报告的告警、漏洞扫描和基线检查结果，智能体需要生成关于入侵情况、基线风险和漏洞风险的取证报告，并提供修复计划。我们在10个网络靶场（cyber ranges）中实例化了这一任务，每个靶场均基于一个独立的受感染云主机构建，涵盖4种入侵入口类型、21种ATT&CK技术和5种操作系统。我们利用OpenCode智能体框架评估了23种前沿的LLM。实验结果表明，尽管当前的智能体能够可靠地发现告警所揭示的问题，但在主动调查磁盘以发现静默入侵（silent intrusions）以及生成全面且经过验证的修复计划方面仍存在困难，没有任何模型能在单个靶场上实现完全的检测与修复。这揭示了构建用于真实事件响应智能体的一个根本性瓶颈。本基准已通过此链接公开提供：https URL。

2607.27205.short_zh: 实时轻量视觉语言动作模型
2607.27205.tags: 机器人学;机器人控制;视觉语言动作模型
2607.27205.body_summary:
现有视觉语言动作模型采用LLM中心架构，计算和内存开销大
提出TurboVLA直接映射视觉语言到动作，实现高效实时推理

2607.27180.short_zh: 评测视觉语言模型身体控制能力
2607.27180.tags: 具身智能;视觉语言模型;物理世界交互
2607.27180.body_summary:
评估视觉语言模型能否通过物理身体执行任务存在执行与决策耦合的挑战。
提出HumanCLAW框架，通过解耦决策与执行来评测模型的动作智能，并构建了包含大量长时序任务的基准测试。

2607.25675.short_zh: 解耦协同优化文本技能
2607.25675.tags: 自然语言处理;模型优化;开放式任务协同进化
2607.25675.body_summary:
现有文本空间优化方法在开放式任务中，因固定评估标准而难以发现模型未知弱点。
通过解耦目标协同进化解题与评估生成技能，无需标准答案即可提升模型综合表现。

2607.25294.short_zh: 评估多模态上下文学习能力
2607.25294.tags: 多模态模型；上下文学习；多模态基准构建
2607.25294.body_summary:
现实任务常需模型从任务特定多模态上下文中学习而非仅依赖预训练知识
本文提出CLBench-V基准从三个维度系统评估多模态上下文学习并发现现有模型表现不佳

2607.25659.short_zh: 基于准则的强化学习优化方法
2607.25659.tags: 自然语言处理;语言模型对齐与强化学习;基于准则的强化学习
2607.25659.body_summary:
在基于准则（Rubric）的强化学习框架中，现有方法通常将结构化准则评判压缩为整体响应层面的单一奖励，并均匀地分配给所有生成标记，缺乏对响应内部不同部分贡献的精细信用分配机制。
我们提出了CoRT方法，它利用反事实重放技术，通过对比模型在有/无准则上下文提示下生成同一响应的标记级对数似然差异，将其作为信用权重来重新分配GRPO优势信号，从而实现响应内部的精细信用分配，无需引入额外的标记评分模型。

2607.25308.short_zh: 用游戏求解器帮助大语言模型学习决策
2607.25308.tags: 强化学习;决策智能;游戏决策训练
2607.25308.body_summary:
训练大语言模型玩长序列游戏是通往通用决策的重要一步，但现有方法依赖稀疏最终奖励，难以判断每一步动作的好坏。
我们提出CAST方法，利用游戏求解器评估动作带来的状态价值变化作为每步指导信号，显著提升了多种游戏中模型的决策表现和泛化能力。

2607.26784.short_zh: 跨任务技能进化的智能体学习
2607.26784.tags: 强化学习;智能体学习;跨任务技能抽取与复用
2607.26784.body_summary:
大型语言模型(LLM)智能体在处理一系列相关但不同的任务时，需要复用已有的解决方案模式，但现有方法常将任务孤立处理或使用多阶段复杂流程。
提出了SkillRise框架，通过统一强化学习策略交替执行任务和整理跨任务技能文档，实现技能的提取与演进，在多个基准测试中显著提升了单次尝试通过率并降低了运行开销。

2607.27155.short_zh: 评测LLM执行办公长任务成本
2607.27155.tags: 自然语言处理;大语言模型评测;办公软件任务基准
2607.27155.body_summary:
现有基准难以评估大语言模型代理以合理成本完成办公套件长期工作流的能力。
我们提出了结合经济信号（人力成本与任务价格）的基准OmegaUse-OfficeVal，包含100个任务并开发了基于代码的验证器，评估发现当前模型成本更低但质量未达人类水平。

2607.27191.short_zh: AI能否自主进行开放性研究
2607.27191.tags: 人工智能评估方法;AI研究自动化;AI智能体开放性研究评估
2607.27191.body_summary:
目前缺乏AI能否自主进行开放性研究的证据，现有评估方法存在局限。
我们提出了一种新评估方法，让AI智能体尝试解决未发表论文的核心问题，由原作者评审，发现当前AI能完成工程任务但难以推进研究。

2607.25802.short_zh: 视频层级建模提升插入与分解效果
2607.25802.tags: 计算机视觉;视频编辑;视频层分解与合成
2607.25802.body_summary:
现有视频编辑缺乏显式层级表示，限制了真实合成与分解能力。
本文构建三元视频数据集TriLayer，提出双分支扩散模型DBL-Diffusion，实现显式层级建模。

2607.26115.short_zh: 训练AI攻击手提升大模型安全
2607.26115.tags: 大语言模型安全;对抗性训练;自动化红队测试
2607.26115.body_summary:
为评估和提升大语言模型在生产环境中的鲁棒性，需要开发高效的自动化测试方法。
提出了一个名为GPT-Red的自动化红队代理，通过大规模自我博弈算法训练，能有效发现新的提示注入攻击，并用于对抗性训练以增强GPT-5.6等模型的防御能力。

2607.26314.short_zh: 测攻防智能体隐蔽操作能力
2607.26314.tags: 网络安全;自主攻防测试;隐蔽性评估基准
2607.26314.body_summary:
背景/任务：在网络安全攻防中，隐蔽性至关重要，但现有自主攻防智能体常因操作不当暴露自身。
做了什么：构建了StealthBench基准，从真实攻防轨迹中提取场景，用多模型评审评估智能体的任务成功率与隐蔽性，发现其隐蔽失败是系统性问题并开源基准。

2607.24117.tags: 知识工程；多智能体系统；知识溯源可靠性评估
2607.24117.body_summary:
现代多智能体知识系统通过长链式自主转换积累知识，但缺乏对传播链逐环节可靠性评估的框架。
借鉴伊斯兰圣训学方法，构建了可对知识传播链评级并隔离可疑内容的形式化框架，并在物理教材知识上验证了部分机制的有效性。

2607.26791.short_zh: 评估大模型代理事后应急响应能力
2607.26791.tags: 网络安全;安全运营;事后应急响应基准
2607.26791.body_summary:
现有大模型代理评估主要关注攻击前的理想环境，缺乏对真实失陷后应急响应场景的评估。
构建首个事后应急响应基准SecRespond，包含10个真实失陷主机场景，评估23个前沿大模型的应急响应能力，发现其在主动调查与制定完整修复计划方面存在瓶颈。
